svg.title: fig01
svg.desc: Figure 1 | The same robot behaviour with less computation. (a) Coincident measured reference and optimized robot paths in the authenticated perfect-maze, six-robot, seed-11 held-out scene. Solid blue and dashed dark lines use the same coordinates, with no visual offset. Open markers show initial positions; filled robot discs and heading ticks show final poses. The 100 m × 100 m arena uses the simulator coordinate frame, with y increasing downward. (b) Both builds retain the sensing, GBP, and motion sequence. The schematic introduces the unchanged execution order; implementation changes are located in Figure 2. Trajectory CSV rows contain a compact initial/post-update sample of 101 poses per robot from a 200-frame exact paired replay.
